baselines.notes: Baseline comparisons (BM25/TF-IDF vs embedding retriever, base model vs adapted) are tracked in the experiments/ directory of the companion ML pipeline.

dataset: v0.1-sample (295 curated records, synthetic seed data)

grounding.notes: Answers are composed only from retrieved knowledge-base records; low-confidence queries trigger clarifying questions instead of guesses.

safety.notes: Exact pesticide/fertilizer dosages are withheld unless crop, formulation, region and authoritative guidance are available.

split_notes: Leakage-controlled split: no ID overlap between splits; Unicode-safe near-duplicate check found 0.0% duplicates.
